title: jacobaea erucifolia subsp. grandidentata
intro: Jacobaea erucifolia subsp. grandidentata, commonly known as Woolly Groundsel, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Groundsel include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiviral and antibacterial properties, and show potential in treating various health conditions such as cancer and cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Groundsel include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
